principles: Logos, main actions and bounded content share a centered axis.
Parallel actions have equal widths and balanced gaps where space permits.
Form labels and answer text remain left aligned for reading.
Content grows or stacks for large text; vertical scrolling is allowed.
No hidden overflow, font shrinking or omitted controls to make a test pass.
Images preserve their aspect ratio and remain fully visible.
Visual appeal still requires reviewing the saved screenshots.

scope: Actual SwiftUI views and real WebKit at logical available-content sizes, run on both simulator families. This does not emulate every hardware model or OS release.
